name: State Secrets
summary: Shaw’s right-hand goblin may be able to make sense of documents recovered in Westfall. You bring the box to him for a look.

sections.title: The Documents
sections.body: In Westfall, you found documents beneath the floorboards of a building and brought them back. Now Shaw’s right-hand goblin examines the box. His reaction suggests the papers matter, though what they contain remains unclear.

faq.answer: Shaw’s right-hand goblin, Renzik, examines the box of documents.

faq.q: Where did the documents come from?
faq.answer: You recovered them from beneath floorboards in a building in Westfall.

faq.q: What does Renzik think of the documents?
faq.answer: Renzik’s eyes widen when you show him the box, but his words do not explain what the documents mean.
Renzik asks where you found the documents.
